reels.title: Chang’e-6 lunar soil contains a surprising magnetic time capsule
reels.hook: Chang’e-6 lunar soil contains a surprising magnetic time capsule

beats.caption: Chang’e-6 lunar soil contains a surprising magnetic time capsule
How can a handful of moon dirt act like a time machine?
beats.detail: Scientists are analyzing new Chang’e-6 soil samples.
beats.narration: How can a handful of moon dirt act like a time machine? Scientists are asking that right now.

beats.caption: The mission found a secret magnetic mineral inside.
beats.detail: Hidden within tiny impact glass particles.
beats.narration: The Chang’e-6 mission brought back samples containing a magnetic mineral never seen before in natural moon soil.

beats.caption: It is a rare metallic iron called gamma-iron.
beats.narration: This mineral is a specific form of metallic iron called gamma-iron, which forms inside tiny impact glass.

beats.caption: This iron can lock in a stable magnetic signal.
beats.narration: Because it is stable, this iron essentially locks in a magnetic signal from the moment it formed.

beats.caption: It gives us a fossil of the moon’s magnetic past.
beats.detail: A window into ancient lunar conditions.
beats.narration: It serves as a fossil of the moon’s magnetic history, providing a window into ancient lunar conditions.

beats.caption: This helps us reconstruct the moon's early history.
beats.narration: Researchers hope this discovery helps them reconstruct what the moon's magnetic field looked like long ago.

story_card.headline: France to share files on 1980 Ustica plane crash
story_card.standfirst: New documents could finally explain why a passenger jet crashed near Italy decades ago.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: France is sharing defense files with Italian judges about a 1980 passenger jet crash.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: A former Italian president claimed a French fighter jet accidentally shot the plane down.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These files might finally confirm or disprove the theory that a stray missile caused the tragedy.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Italian investigators will now review the documents to see if they hold any new evidence.

story_card.caption:
France is releasing defense documents related to the 1980 Ustica plane crash investigation.

For decades, the crash has been a mystery, with theories pointing toward an accidental missile strike. While some remain skeptical about what the files will reveal, this cooperation marks a significant step forward.
